scope: Selected evidence-producing source implementations and exact shipped FIR assets; not an executable dependency closure.

sourceAnalysis.scope: Sequential source windows produce immutable all-pitch observations with source sample identity, half-open ownership and analyzed-through coverage. Source event time and publication availability use separate clocks. No score, target or verdict enters source analysis.

sourcePublication.scope: Immutable source observations use half-open ownership and a publication clock independent of source event time.

decoder.scope: Contiguous onset regions choose the first maximum, gate on frame support and retain the minimum confidence. Events sort by time then pitch.

windowPlanner.scope: Half-open sample ownership uses real past and future context; final partial ownership shifts the full input without padding.

sourceAdapter.scope: Rational FIR uses float32 products and each accumulation, persistent bounded source state, origin zeros only and no fitted shift or gain normalization.

coefficientAssets.scope: Exact raw float32 little-endian FIR bytes declared by the runtime contract.
